title: Style archetype quiz: find your style in five questions
description: A free style archetype quiz with no photo. Answer five questions and get a style name, three signature pieces and what to upgrade.
headline: Find your style archetype in five questions
sub: No photo needed. Five questions, one style name, three pieces to start with.
how_it_works: Pick your door, men or women.
Answer five questions: where you wear your clothes, your climate, your occasions, your budget per item and your vibe.
Get your style archetype, three signature pieces and two upgrades.
what_you_get: A style name such as Quiet Sharp or Soft Romantic, in two words you can remember.
A one-line description of what that style looks like in plain words.
Three signature pieces to build around.
Two upgrades, each phrased as a swap rather than a rule.
An option to add a selfie and get your colour season too.

sample.one_line: Neat and comfortable together. You look finished and still relaxed.
signature_pieces: A fluid shirt or kurta in a good fabric
avoid_list: Swap stiff, clingy fabrics for fluid drape
Swap busy accessories for one good bag and one good pair of earrings
sample.famous_for: You carry fluid structure well; clean lines and soft drape make you look pulled together.

faq.q: Is a style archetype a label I am stuck with?
faq.a: No. It is a starting point. Most people sit between two styles. The name gives you a direction, and you can change it when your life changes.

faq.q: Why does my answer about vibe matter most?
faq.a: Your vibe sets the style family. The other answers, like climate and budget, set which versions of it you can use.

faq.q: Do I need to upload a photo?
faq.a: Not for this tool. If you want your colour season too, add one selfie in daylight.

faq.q: Are all eight styles equally good?
faq.a: Yes. Each one is a different way to look well put together. None is better than another.

intro: You may already know what you like to wear. You may not have a name for it. A style archetype gives it a name, so you can shop with a clear idea instead of scrolling for hours. This quiz uses five questions and no photo. It is the fastest way to get a direction. There are eight styles for men and eight for women. None is better than another. Each is a different way to look well put together.
tips: Answer for the life you have, not the one you wish you had.
If two answers fit, pick the one you use more days of the week.
Retake the quiz when your job or city changes.
Add a selfie after the quiz to get your colour season too.
honesty: The quiz gives you a name and three pieces to start with. It never tells you what you cannot wear. Every upgrade is a swap, and every swap has a reason.
